newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's crude price up to $20.75 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's crude price up to $20.75 per barrel.

text.p: The reference price of Ecuador's crude rose to an average $20.75 per barrel on September 10, up from the $20.43 registered the day before, a spokesman for the state-run Petroecuador oil company said Monday.
The price is tied to the Alaska North Slope (USG) price and Oman crude price, with different discounts payable in 30 days.
The average price in August 1996 was 18.51 per barrel, while in August 1995 it was $14.63 per barrel.
Ecuador withdrew from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) in December 1992.
